program.name: Bell Pilates Strength
program.subject: Kettlebell Pilates
program.blurb: Kettlebell Pilates, then slow bell lifts for strength under control.
program.about: Pilates control with a little more strength. Each session is a bell Pilates sequence, then slow straight sets of goblet squats, halos and windmills with the same bell, then rolling on the mat. Two sessions alternate. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Bell Pilates & slow bell lifts A / B
